## Description

_Job ID: 111270_

_At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive._

#### Responsibilities:

- Responsible for influencing product roadmaps through analytics and financial and business modeling.
- Develop hypotheses and analytical frameworks for understanding pricing dynamics and market outcomes.
- Analyze collected data and extract information relevant to problems.
- Work closely with product leads to build efficient tools, systems, and processes to manage pricing and driver earning at scale.
- Develop and test quantitative models, support software, and analytical tools.

#### Experience:

Education and Experience:

- Master's degree or foreign equivalent in Operations Research, Analytics, or related field.
- 3 years of experience in job offered, analytics, or related occupation.

Skills:

- Experience with quantitative analysis, predictive modeling, and machine learning.
- Experience with programming languages, analytical software, and database applications.
- Experience with business analytics and authoring data pipelines.
- Experience with optimization and programming, including C++, R, Python, and algorithms.

#### Benefits:

- Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
- Mental health benefits
- Family building benefits
- Child care and pet benefits
- 401(k) plan to help save for your future
- In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
- 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
- Subsidized commuter benefits
- Lyft Pink - Lyft team members get an exclusive opportunity to test new benefits of our Ridership Program
